name: Forward Difference Gradient
definition: Gradient estimation taking four neighboring voxels as input. For a voxel V at (x, y, z), the gradient components are calculated using forward differences.
summary: The Forward Difference Gradient is a first-order finite difference method that approximates spatial gradients for volume rendering lighting by subtracting the current voxel value from the next, offering lower computational cost and directional bias compared to central differences.
